name: gpa-floor
description: Cumulative GPA below 3.0: the §2.2 floor is unmet and the defense rows carry the 'may not defend' gate note. Since 2026-10-03 (P1-gpa-8) the candidacy row keeps the two conditions apart: the coursework comes before the EXAM (§4.5), the 3.0 before ADMISSION to candidacy (§2.2).

detailIncludes: You can take the exam once your 24 regular-course credits are complete or in progress
and be admitted to candidacy once your cumulative GPA is 3.0 or higher — it is 2.90 (§2.2)
